dialog: Saving lives is my mission.
No Blight can withstand my blade!
I would sacrifice everything to protect my family.
God, please save us.
Spring will come, and everything will get better.
These shoes are uncomfortable.
Light the torch!
Keep going, and don't back down.
Perhaps the gods don't exist...
I will never fall!
Don't even think about stopping me!
Maybe add some bark?
Where there's life, there's hope.
My husband is the most formidable warrior!
May the fallen rest in peace.
Animal lives are precious too.
My wife, she's the most beautiful angel.
I will protect this land with my life.
I will block all the rat holes!
After the disaster, I want to travel out of the city.
Wonder how the other towns are doing...
Father, I will protect our homeland.
Keep all enemies at bay!
As long as the town remains, loneliness won't be felt.
Clean up and stay healthy.
Everyone will die, but not by my hand.
We will prevail!
When everything awakens, I'll plant the most beautiful flowers.
Blight! Oh... it's just the shadow of a tree...
The potion's mixture is truly fascinating...
Gold and silver have long lost their value.
When will the Blight finally vanish...
The wind is picking up...
Stay alert!
Hope this nightmare ends soon.
Smell that? It's the aroma of my freshly baked bread!
How are my friends back home...
Wear gloves before handling items.
Life and death are under my control.
Received a plea for help from other towns...
Lost another bloodletting jar.
The herbs in the mask can last a while longer.
I won't let the Blight get close here.
I will be one step ahead of death.
Really miss the Mayor's hearty laughter.
People need miracles.
Wolves are howling outside. Hope they don't come over.
I will fulfill my mother's last wish and become a warrior.
I will make the Black Wizard pay!
There seems to be movement outside the city!
It's great to be alive...
Thanks to the doctor, we can still survive.
Great job saving more lives.
How long can this peace last?
I once had other dreams...
When will this disaster finally end?
I can wear new clothes tomorrow!
Wish I could return to my cozy bed.
Last night's vegetable soup was delicious...
Even in the face of plague, force is still needed for protection.
I hate lice!
Pesky rats!
Hope will endure.
A long journey ahead...
I also want to help others.
Go home and taste my homemade wine!
Strength is nothing against disease.
My beloved is gone, leaving me alone...
Tears won't save us.
Pray...
